item: disk-full warning (backlog #58, register 1.26): system/session_writes_lost draws as a warning line instead of being dropped
branch: case 'session_writes_lost' in bannerLine (50-blocks.js), reached through BANNER_SUBTYPES from 70-events.js
provenance: SCHEMA-SHAPED, never seen on a wire: the frame shape is read from the CLI 2.1.330 binary's own definition ({type:'system', subtype:'session_writes_lost', error_code:'ENOSPC'|'EDQUOT', lost:['transcript'|'global_config'], transcript_session_ids?, uuid, session_id}) and from its one call site, which writes it once at the end of a stream-json run whose writes failed. No real frame can be provoked without filling the disk. RUN 2026-11-22 against the sandbox serving HEAD's whole webview directory (c5a14b5): 9 FAILED / 0 passed; 9/9 after the change.
